summary: Iteration 4 (Shift Summary, Learner Signup, Admin Escalation) tested end-to-end. Backend: 35/35 pytest cases pass (29 regression + 6 new). Frontend: signup flow, toggle back to sign-in, demo logins, guard Shift Summary dialog, and Admin Escalations panel all working. Aging monitor correctly escalates a package to reminder_count=3 with escalated=true within ~60s, and it disappears from the panel after pickup.

design_issues.screen: Guard Shift Summary dialog / other Dialogs
issues: Radix DialogContent warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' — accessibility polish. Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to DialogContent.

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to shift-summary-dialog and other DialogContent instances to silence a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: check_aging cutoff logic uses last_reminder_at > cutoff to suppress duplicates. With aging_hours=1 and a 2-day-old last_reminder_at, the next reminder fires as expected; but if an admin later raises aging_hours (e.g., back to 24) between reminders, the cutoff shifts and could allow another reminder sooner than intended. Consider using a fixed min-interval (e.g., 24h) between reminders independent of aging_hours.
seed_data_creation: During test setup an escalated delivery was created for UI verification and then picked up. aging_hours restored to 24. A signup account test_signup_<ts>@rishihood.edu.in was created (harmless per instructions).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 35 backend pytest cases pass. test_iteration4.py's TestShiftSummary.test_summary_reflects_flow was made parallel-safe (compare waiting after pickup to after_arrive-1, not before). Escalation test relies on aging monitor loop (~60s) — polls up to 95s. Frontend flows verified via Playwright. Note: escalated packages only show in /api/admin/stats.escalated while status='arrived'.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no failing behavior observed. Minor a11y console warning about DialogContent missing description is a cosmetic Radix warning.
